notes: «حدثتني جدتاى، صفية ودحيبة» is one link: the dual relation is followed by the names, so the names stand alone (rule 7)
«- المعنى واحد -» and «- تعني حريث ... -» are glosses, left out; the man in the saying is in the scene, not a link
«أنها أخبرتهما» names قيلة through a pronoun; the saying is a first-person narrative («قدمنا», «قالت») with the speaker implicit, so flagged under rule 11
